title: 第513章 困战第512章 领主级石像鬼
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: 鲜血染红了石像鬼的身躯，城头上的士兵都被他吃的差不多了。
摄取了足够多的血肉后，
石像鬼僵硬的石质身躯渐渐褪去死寂。
石质皮肤上浮现出淡淡的暗光，四肢动作愈发流畅灵动，彻底摆脱了最初那僵硬木讷的模样。
罗威伯爵一脸兴奋：“马瑟，快点，指挥石像鬼杀了这些入侵者。”
“石像鬼，去杀了那个女人。”
马瑟使用精神力沟通卡牌。
这一次，彻底复苏的石像鬼总算接收到作战命令。
双翼一振，带着呼啸狂风，直直朝着战场核心的安琪拉俯冲而去。
“安琪，小心！”
莫菲拉占据高空领地，
一双眼睛已经变成了黑暗之鸦的瞳孔形态。
黑夜之中的一切事物在她眼前都无所遁形。
“咻咻咻！”
莫菲拉连射三支破甲箭，箭矢精准命中石像鬼身躯。
可这平日里足以贯穿重甲的特制箭矢，
落在石像鬼身躯上，竟然只是擦出点火星，无法造成一点伤害。
“糟糕。”
面对俯冲而来的恶鬼，安琪拉瞳孔骤缩，连忙举起卡牌。
轰！
熊熊烈焰喷涌而出，化作一片火海将石像鬼吞噬。
莫菲拉刚刚松一口气，下一秒却异变突生。
随着石像鬼一声嘶吼，
一只漆黑细长的利爪竟然撕开漫天火焰，精准打在安琪拉胸膛。
一口热血喷洒半空。
安琪拉娇小的身躯如同断线风筝，被石像鬼狠狠轰飞，重重摔落在地，生死不知。
“安琪！”
莫菲拉看得目眦欲裂，脚下黑暗之鸦俯冲而下，直直冲向石像鬼。
“安琪拉姐姐！”
梅比斯也发现了这边的状况，小短腿一路狂奔，朝着安琪拉被打落的方向追去。
“梅比斯？”
黑暗之中，
林奇在陨火流星雨的范围之外，操纵着这一场天灾。
content_en:
Blood dyed the gargoyle's body red, and almost all the soldiers on the city were eaten by him.
After taking in enough flesh and blood,
The stiff stone body of the gargoyle gradually faded away from its deathly silence.
A faint dark light appeared on the stone skin, and the movements of the limbs became smoother and more agile, completely getting rid of the initial stiff and wooden look.
Count Lowe looked excited: "Mather, hurry up and command the gargoyles to kill these intruders."
"Gargoyle, kill that woman."
Mather uses psychic communication cards.
This time, the fully revived Gargoyle finally received combat orders.
The wings flapped, carrying the roaring wind, and dived straight towards Angela at the core of the battlefield.
"An Qi, be careful!"
Mo Feila occupies the high-altitude territory,
A pair of eyes have turned into the pupils of the Dark Crow.
Everything in the dark night was invisible to her.
"Boohoo!"
Mo Feila shot three armor-piercing arrows in a row, and the arrows accurately hit the gargoyle's body.
But this special arrow, which is usually capable of penetrating heavy armor,
When it landed on the body of the gargoyle, it only caused a few sparks and could not cause any damage.
"Oops."
Facing the swooping evil ghost, Angela's pupils shrank suddenly and she quickly raised the card.
boom!
Raging flames spurted out, turning into a sea of ​​fire and swallowing the gargoyle.
Mo Feila just breathed a sigh of relief, but something changed suddenly the next second.
"Hiss!"
As the gargoyle roared,
A dark and slender claw actually tore through the flames in the sky and hit Angela's chest accurately.
"Pfft..."
A mouthful of hot blood sprayed into the air.
Angela's petite body was like a kite with a broken string, and was violently blown away by the gargoyle. She fell heavily to the ground, and she didn't know whether she was alive or dead.
"Angel!"
Mo Feila's eyes were about to burst when he saw it, and the dark crow swooped down under his feet, rushing straight towards the gargoyle.
"Sister Angela!"
Mavis also noticed the situation here, and ran wildly with his short legs, chasing in the direction where Angela was knocked down.
"Mavis?"
in the darkness,
Lynch controlled this natural disaster outside the scope of the meteor shower.
